units.source_text: 到了最后，鬼卒们也无计可施，

en.t: In the end, even the demon guards were at a loss,

units.source_text: 他们只能再次飞上暗无天日的天空，

en.t: they could only fly up once more into the sunless dark sky,

units.source_text: 回到阎罗殿，就像刚才一样将杜子春按倒在阶前，

en.t: returned to the Hall of King Yama, and just as before forced Duzichun down before the steps,

units.source_text: 并齐声向阎罗殿上阎罗王汇报：

en.t: and reported in one voice to King Yama seated in the hall:
